title: AssayProcedurePack
description: Named assay procedure overlay: library protocol + SamplePrep/lifecycle pointers + science defaults for a methylation matrix recipe. Merges under instance context and over profile/mode (instance → procedure → profile → analyte → site).

pipelineProcedure.description: Stable procedure id (filename stem), e.g. buffy_wgbs_pangenome_gene_fc.

pipelineProfile.description: Default SaMD/research profile when instance omits pipelineProfile (usually samd_research).

analyteExpectation.description: Required study regulatory.primary_analyte (string or list of allowed tokens).

samplePrepProgram.description: DomainProgram path or fixture name for SamplePrep (operator / portal hint).

lifecycleProgram.description: DomainProgram path or fixture name for post-MC lifecycle (operator / portal hint).
